name: guito
description: Explore and manage the current Git repository with Guito inside VS Code.

guito.azureDevOpsUrl.description: Base URL of your on-prem Azure DevOps Server (e.g. https://server/DefaultCollection). Enables the Create Pull Request action in the push menu. Requests authenticate with Windows integrated auth (your current Windows session).

guito.prBranchNameTemplate.description: Branch name template used when Guito creates a new branch for a pull request. Variables: ${username} (computer user), ${randomstring}, ${branch}, ${targetbranch}, ${title}, ${repository}, ${date} (UTC YYYY-MM-DD), ${time} (UTC HHmmss), and ${timestamp}.

guito.autoReload.description: Automatically reload commits and the working tree when the repository changes outside Guito (for example from a terminal).

enumDescriptions: Open file diffs in Guito's own dialog inside the Guito panel.
Open file diffs in the native VS Code diff tab.
guito.diffViewer.description: Where file diffs open when you click a file in Guito.

guito.showGraph.description: Show the Git graph beside the commit history.

guito.showStashes.description: Show stash entries above the commit history.

guito.showTags.description: Show tag badges attached to commits.

guito.showRemoteBranches.description: Show remote branches in the repository panel and history decorations.

enumDescriptions: Show changed files as a flat list with full paths.
Group changed files into a collapsible directory tree.

guito.issueRegex.description: Regular expression used to recognize issue references in commit messages, for example #(\d+).

guito.issueUrl.description: Issue URL template. Capture groups from the issue regex can be inserted with $1, $2, and so on.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check && npm run build
